ig_followers.label: IG followers
ig_followers.rule: six-month pre-pause average 29.4/month rounded to 30; baseline = first board reading on 2026-11-02, rungs = baseline + 30 and + 60

ig_followback_pct.label: IG follow-back
ig_followback_pct.rule: mean of the May to Sep 2026 cohorts (23.2) minus 3, rounded down to 5

spotify_monthly_active.label: Spotify monthly listeners
spotify_monthly_active.rule: Nov = 12-week mean 91.75 rounded to 90; Dec = best 4-week mean of the last six months, 109 (Oct 5 to 30), rounded to 110

spotify_followers.label: Spotify followers
spotify_followers.rule: D4 (2026-11-05): fan number for the songs. Baseline = Monday S4A read of 2026-10-31; rungs +12 and +22 on the six-month pace (49 to 68, Apr to Oct 2026, about 3.5/month) lifted for the first song. Proposed by Claude 2026-11-05, confirmed by Amir 2026-11-06.

email_list.label: Email list
email_list.rule: D4 (2026-11-05): Bandcamp mailing list, 16 addresses on 2026-11-05, typed in by hand (python3 stats/manual_entry.py email_list subscribers N). Rungs 30 and 50 assume a sign-up ask goes live with the first song. Proposed by Claude 2026-11-05, confirmed by Amir 2026-11-06.

release_engagement_d28.label: Release engagement, day 28
release_engagement_d28.rule: D4 (2026-11-05): no rung. Baseline = the first day-28 read of Half the Night; rungs are set after that read. Until then the card collects.

schema.where: releases/<slug>.json -> outcomes.stats.engagement_d28 (one object per release, written on day 28 after the release date)

fields.value: integer, fan actions in the first 28 days: the sum of parts
fields.parts: object of the counted actions, e.g. spotify_saves, spotify_playlist_adds, sc_likes, sc_reposts, ig_comments, ig_shares, bandcamp_follows
fields.source: where each number was read, e.g. S4A song page, SC stats, IG insights

schema.reader: release_manager.score_board reads every releases/*.json (backups skipped) and plots one point per release at as_of; the newest release is the card value
